questions.stem: 函数 $\begin{array} { r } { f ( x ) = \frac { x ^ { 2 } - x } { x ^ { 2 } - 1 } \sqrt { 1 + \frac { 1 } { x ^ { 2 } } } } \\ { ( \mathrm { B } ) \ 1 . } \end{array}$ 的无穷间断点的个数为· · · ·
questions.explanation:
解. 应选(B)．易知 f (x)有间断点 $x = 0 , \pm 1$ ．因为

$$
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {x (x - 1)}{(x + 1) (x - 1)} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} x \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} = 1,
$$

$$
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} \frac {x (x - 1)}{(x + 1) (x - 1)} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} x \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} = - 1,
$$

所以 x =0为跳跃间断点．因为

$$
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} f (x) = \frac {1}{2} \sqrt {1 + 1} = \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2},
$$

所以 x = 1 为可去间断点点．因为

$$
\lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} \frac {x (x - 1)}{(x + 1) (x - 1)} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} = \infty ,
$$

所以 x = −1 为无穷间断点．总之，无穷间断点仅有一个

questions.stem: 设 $y _ { 1 } , y _ { 2 }$ 是一阶线性非齐次微分方程 $y ^ { \prime } + p ( x ) y = q ( x )$ 的两个特解，若常数 λ,µ使 $\lambda y _ { 1 } + \mu y _ { 2 }$ 是该方程的解， $\lambda y _ { 1 } - \mu y _ { 2 }$ 是该方程对应的齐次方程的解，则 · ( )
questions.explanation: 解. 应选 (A)．因为 $\lambda y _ { 1 } + \mu y _ { 2 }$ 是非齐次微分方程 $y ^ { \prime } + p ( x ) y = q ( x )$ 的解，代入方程解得 $\lambda + \mu = 1$ ；又因为 $\lambda y _ { 1 } - \mu y _ { 2 }$ 是 $y ^ { \prime } + p ( x ) y = 0$ 的解，代入方程求得 $\lambda - \mu = 0$ 由此可求得 λ = µ = 1． $\lambda = \mu = \frac { 1 } { 2 }$

questions.stem: 设向量组Ⅰ： $a _ { 1 } , a _ { 2 } , \cdots , a _ { r }$ 可由向量组Ⅱ： $\beta _ { 1 } , \beta _ { 2 } , \cdots , \beta _ { s }$ 线性表示，下列命题正确的是· · · ·

options.label: A
options.value: 若向量组Ⅰ线性无关，则 $r \leqslant s .$

options.label: B
options.value: 若向量组Ⅰ线性相关，则 $r > s$

options.label: C
options.value: 若向量组Ⅱ线性无关，则 $r \leqslant s .$

options.label: D
options.value: 若向量组Ⅱ线性相关，则 $r > s$

questions.explanation:
解. 应选 (A)．由于向量组Ⅰ能由向量组Ⅱ线性表示，所以

$$
r \left(\alpha_ {1}, \dots , \alpha_ {r}\right) \leqslant r \left(\beta_ {1}, \dots , \beta_ {s}\right) \leqslant s.
$$

若向量组Ⅰ线性无关，则 $r ( \alpha _ { 1 } , \cdots , \alpha _ { r } ) = r$ ，所以

$$
r = r \left(\alpha_ {1}, \dots , \alpha_ {r}\right) \leqslant r \left(\beta_ {1}, \dots , \beta_ {s}\right) \leqslant s,
$$

即有 $r \leqslant s$

questions.stem: 已知一个长方形的长 l 以 $2 \mathrm { c m } / \mathrm { s }$ 的速率增加，宽 w 以 3cm/s 的速率增加．则当 $l = 1 2 \mathrm { c m } , \ : \ : \ : w = 5 \mathrm { c m }$ 时，它的对角线增加的速率为
questions.answer: $3 \mathrm { c m } / \mathrm { s }$ ．设 $l = x ( t ) , w = y ( t )$ ，由题意知，在 $t = t _ { 0 }$ 时刻 $x ( t _ { 0 } ) = 1 2 , y ( t _ { 0 } ) = 5$ ，且 $x ^ { \prime } ( t _ { 0 } ) = 2 , y ^ { \prime } ( t _ { 0 } ) = 3$ ．设该对角线长为 S(t )，则
questions.explanation:
解. 应填 $3 \mathrm { c m } / \mathrm { s }$ ．设 $l = x ( t ) , w = y ( t )$ ，由题意知，在 $t = t _ { 0 }$ 时刻 $x ( t _ { 0 } ) = 1 2 , y ( t _ { 0 } ) = 5$ ，且 $x ^ { \prime } ( t _ { 0 } ) = 2 , y ^ { \prime } ( t _ { 0 } ) = 3$ ．设该对角线长为 S(t )，则

$$
S (t) = \sqrt {x ^ {2} (t) + y ^ {2} (t)} \Rightarrow S ^ {\prime} (t) = \frac {x (t) x ^ {\prime} (t) + y (t) y ^ {\prime} (t)}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} (t) + y ^ {2} (t)}}.
$$

代入易知数据可得

$$
S ^ {\prime} (t _ {0}) = \frac {x (t _ {0}) x ^ {\prime} (t _ {0}) + y (t _ {0}) y ^ {\prime} (t _ {0})}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} (t _ {0}) + y ^ {2} (t _ {0})}} = \frac {1 2 \cdot 2 + 5 \cdot 3}{\sqrt {1 2 ^ {2} + 5 ^ {2}}} = 3.
$$

questions.stem: 设 A,B 为 3 阶矩阵，且 $| A | = 3 , | B | = 2 , \left| A ^ { - 1 } + B \right| = 2$ ，则 $\left| A + B ^ { - 1 } \right| =$
questions.explanation:
解. 应填 3．由于 $A ( A ^ { - 1 } + B ) B ^ { - 1 } = ( E + A B ) B ^ { - 1 } = B ^ { - 1 } + A$ ，所以

$$
\left| A + B ^ {- 1} \right| = \left| A (A ^ {- 1} + B) B ^ {- 1} \right| = | A | \left| A ^ {- 1} + B \right| \left| B ^ {- 1} \right| = 3 \times 2 \times \frac {1}{2} = 3.
$$

questions.stem:
（本题满分10分）

设函数 $y = f ( x )$ 由参数方程 $\left\{ \begin{array} { l } { { \boldsymbol { x } } = 2 t + t ^ { 2 } } \\ { { \boldsymbol { y } } = { \boldsymbol { \psi } } ( t ) } \end{array} \right. ( t > - 1 )$ 所确定，其中 $\psi ( t )$ 具有2阶导数，且 $\psi ( 1 ) = { \frac { 5 } { 2 } } , \psi ^ { \prime } ( 1 ) = 6 $ ，ψ0(1) = 6．已知 ${ \frac { \mathrm { d } ^ { 2 } y } { \mathrm { d } x ^ { 2 } } } = { \frac { 3 } { 4 ( 1 + t ) } }$ ， 求函数 $\psi ( t )$
questions.explanation:
解. 根据题意，求导得

$$
\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\mathrm{d} y / d t}{\mathrm{d} x / d t} = \frac {\psi^ {\prime} (t)}{2 t + 2},
$$

$$
\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} t} \left(\frac {\psi^ {\prime} (t)}{2 t + 2}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{\mathrm{d} x / d t} = \frac {\psi^ {\prime \prime} (t) (2 t + 2) - 2 \psi^ {\prime} (t)}{(2 t + 2) ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {1}{2 t + 2} = \frac {3}{4 (1 + t)}.
$$

整理得 $\psi ^ { \prime \prime } ( t ) ( t + 1 ) - \psi ^ { \prime } ( t ) = 3 ( t + 1 ) ^ { 2 }$ ．令 $y = \psi ^ { \prime } ( t )$ ，则有

$$
y ^ {\prime} - \frac {1}{1 + t} y = 3 (1 + t) \Rightarrow y = (1 + t) \left(3 t + C _ {1}\right).
$$

因为 $y ( 1 ) = \psi ^ { \prime } ( 1 ) = 6$ ，所以 $C _ { 1 } = 0$ ，故 $\gamma = 3 t \left( t + 1 \right)$ ，即 $\psi ^ { \prime } ( t ) = 3 t \left( t + 1 \right)$ ．故

$$
\psi (t) = \int 3 t (t + 1) \mathrm{d} t = \frac {3}{2} t ^ {2} + t ^ {3} + C _ {2}.
$$

又由 $\psi ( 1 ) = \frac { 5 } { 2 }$ 得 $C _ { 2 } = 0$ ，故 $\psi ( t ) = \frac { 3 } { 2 } t ^ { 2 } + t ^ { 3 }$

一个高为 l 的柱体形贮油罐，底面是长轴为 $_ { 2 a }$ ，短轴为 2b 的椭圆．现将贮油罐平放，当油罐中油面高度为 ${ \frac { 3 } { 2 } } b$ 时（如图），计算油的质量

![image](https://cdn-mineru.openxlab.org.cn/result/2026-06-13/e449599b-2700-4385-854a-dadd4cdb0815/c6b9e873b37ebb40f02c91808d8a50b6d548585fb4a966ee4e25a973cd091037.jpg)


（长度单位为 m，质量单位为 $\mathrm { k g } ,$ ，油的密度为常数 $\rho \mathrm { k g } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 3 } )$ ）
questions.explanation:
解. 如图建立坐标系，则油罐底面的椭圆方程为 $\frac { x ^ { 2 } } { a ^ { 2 } } + \frac { y ^ { 2 } } { b ^ { 2 } } = 1$ y 

![image](https://cdn-mineru.openxlab.org.cn/result/2026-06-13/e449599b-2700-4385-854a-dadd4cdb0815/0fdb820d1242cc2c189006f494bf0de9d7bfccc47f0f0e17f3c0bdea779a2692.jpg)


阴影部分的面积（其中用到 $y = b \sin t$ 换元）

$$
\begin{array}{l} S = \int_ {- b} ^ {\frac {b}{2}} 2 x \mathrm{d} y = \frac {2 a}{b} \int_ {- b} ^ {\frac {b}{2}} \sqrt {b ^ {2} - y ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} y = 2 a b \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{6}} \cos^ {2} t \mathrm{d} t \\ = 2 a b \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{6}} \left(\frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{2} \cos 2 t\right) d t = \left(\frac {2}{3} \pi + \frac {\sqrt {3}}{4}\right) a b. \\ \end{array}
$$

所以油的质量 $m = \left( \frac { 2 } { 3 } \pi + \frac { \sqrt { 3 } } { 4 } \right) a b l \rho$ ．

（本题满分11分）

设函数 $u = f ( x , y )$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足等式 $4 \frac { \partial ^ { 2 } u } { \partial x ^ { 2 } } + 1 2 \frac { \partial ^ { 2 } u } { \partial x \partial y } + 5 \frac { \partial ^ { 2 } u } { \partial y ^ { 2 } } = 0$ 

确定 a,b 的值，使等式在变换 $\xi = x + a y , \eta = x + b y$ 下化简为 $\frac { \partial ^ { 2 } u } { \partial \xi \partial \eta } = 0$
questions.explanation:
解. 由复合函数链式法则得

$$
\frac {\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial u}{\partial \xi} \cdot \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial u}{\partial y} \cdot \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial u}{\partial \xi} + \frac {\partial u}{\partial \eta},
$$

$$
\frac {\partial u}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial u}{\partial \xi} \cdot \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial u}{\partial \eta} \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial y} = a \frac {\partial u}{\partial \xi} + b \frac {\partial u}{\partial \eta},
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial x ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} \cdot \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} \cdot \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}} + 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta}, \\ \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial x \partial y} = \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} \cdot \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} \cdot \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial y} = a \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} + b \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}} + (a + b) \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta}, \\ \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial y ^ {2}} = a \left(a \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} + b \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta}\right) + b \left(a \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}} + a \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta}\right) = a ^ {2} \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} + b ^ {2} \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}} + 2 a b \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta}. \\ \end{array}
$$

因此 $4 \frac { { \partial } ^ { 2 } u } { \partial x ^ { 2 } } + 1 2 \frac { { \partial } ^ { 2 } u } { \partial x { \partial y } } + 5 \frac { { \partial } ^ { 2 } u } { \partial y ^ { 2 } } = 0$ 变换为

$$
(5 a ^ {2} + 1 2 a + 4) \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} + (5 b ^ {2} + 1 2 b + 4) \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}} + [ 1 2 (a + b) + 1 0 a b + 8 ] \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0.
$$

所以由题设有

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 5 a ^ {2} + 1 2 a + 4 = 0, \\ 5 b ^ {2} + 1 2 b + 4 = 0, \\ 1 2 (a + b) + 1 0 a b + 8 \neq 0. \end{array} \right.
$$

由前两式可解得 $a = - { \frac { 2 } { 5 } }$ 或 $- 2 , b = - \frac { 2 } { 5 }$ $( - 2 , - 2 ) , \left( - \frac { 2 } { 5 } , - \frac { 2 } { 5 } \right)$ 时不满足第三式，所以当 $( a , b )$ 为 $\left( - \frac { 2 } { 5 } , - 2 \right) , \left( - 2 , - \frac { 2 } { 5 } \right)$ 时满足题意．

计算二重积分

$$
I = \iint_ {D} r ^ {2} \sin \theta \sqrt {1 - r ^ {2} \cos 2 \theta} d r d \theta ,
$$

其中 $D = \left\{ ( r , \theta ) { \bigg | } 0 \leqslant r \leqslant \sec \theta , 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant { \frac { \pi } { 4 } } \right\}$
questions.explanation:
解. 将积分区域用直角坐标表示得 $D = \left\{ ( x , y ) { \big | } 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1 , 0 \leqslant y \leqslant x \right\}$ ．所以

$$
\begin{array}{l} I = \iint_ {D} r \sin \theta \sqrt {1 - r ^ {2} (\cos^ {2} \theta - \sin^ {2} \theta)} \cdot r d r d \theta = \iint_ {D} y \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} d x d y \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {x} y \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{3} \left[ 1 - (1 - x ^ {2}) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \right] \mathrm{d} x \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{3} d x - \frac {1}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - x ^ {2}) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} d x = \frac {1}{3} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {4} t d t = \frac {1}{3} - \frac {3}{1 6} \pi . \\ \end{array}
$$

（本题满分10分）

设函数 f (x ) 在闭区间 [0, 1] 上连续，在开区间 (0, 1) 内可导，且 $f ( 0 ) = 0 , f ( 1 ) = \frac { 1 } { 3 }$ 证明：存在 $\xi \in { \left( 0 , \frac { 1 } { 2 } \right) } , \eta \in { \left( \frac { 1 } { 2 } , 1 \right) }$ ，使得 $f ^ { \prime } ( \xi ) + f ^ { \prime } ( \eta ) = \xi ^ { 2 } + \eta ^ { 2 }$ ．
questions.explanation:
解. 令 $F ( x ) = f ( x ) - { \frac { 1 } { 3 } } x ^ { 3 }$ ．对于 F (x ) 分别在 $\left[ 0 , { \frac { 1 } { 2 } } \right]$ 和 $\left[ \frac { 1 } { 2 } , 1 \right]$ 上应用拉格朗日中值定理，得存在 $\xi \in { \left( 0 , \frac { 1 } { 2 } \right) } , \eta \in { \left( \frac { 1 } { 2 } , 1 \right) }$ ，使得

$$
F \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) - F (0) = \frac {1}{2} F ^ {\prime} (\xi), \quad F (1) - F \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) = \frac {1}{2} F ^ {\prime} (\eta).
$$

两式相加，整理得 $f ^ { \prime } ( \xi ) + f ^ { \prime } ( \eta ) = \xi ^ { 2 } + \eta ^ { 2 }$

设 $A = { \left( \begin{array} { l l l } { 0 } & { - 1 } & { 4 } \\ { - 1 } & { 3 } & { a } \\ { 4 } & { a } & { 0 } \end{array} \right) }$ ，正交矩阵 Q 使得 $Q ^ { T } A Q$ 为对角矩阵，若 Q 的第 1 列为$\frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 6 } } ( 1 , 2 , 1 ) ^ { T }$ ，求 $a , Q$ ．
questions.explanation:
解. 由题设，A 对应于 $\lambda _ { 1 }$ 的特征向量为 $\xi _ { 1 } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 6 } } ( 1 , 2 , 1 ) ^ { T }$ ．从而有

$$
\left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & - 1 & 4 \\ - 1 & 3 & a \\ 4 & a & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 2 \\ 1 \end{array} \right) = \lambda_ {1} \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 2 \\ 1 \end{array} \right),
$$

由此可得 $a = - 1 , \lambda _ { 1 } = 2$ ．故有

$$
A = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & - 1 & 4 \\ - 1 & 3 & - 1 \\ 4 & - 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \quad \Rightarrow \quad | \lambda E - A | = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda & 1 & - 4 \\ 1 & \lambda - 3 & 1 \\ - 4 & 1 & \lambda \end{array} \right| = (\lambda + 4) (\lambda - 2) (\lambda - 5).
$$

由此可得 A 的特征值为 $\lambda _ { 1 } = 2 , \lambda _ { 2 } = - 4 , \lambda _ { 3 } = 5$ ．由 $( \lambda _ { 2 } E - A ) x = 0$ ，可解得对应于 $\lambda _ { 2 } = - 4$ 的线性无关的特征向量为 $\xi _ { 2 } = ( - 1 , 0 , 1 ) ^ { T }$ ．由 $( \lambda _ { 3 } E - A ) x = 0$ ，可解得对应于 $\lambda _ { 3 } = 5$ 的特征向量为 $\xi _ { 3 } = ( 1 , - 1 , 1 ) ^ { T }$ ．将 $\xi _ { 1 } , \xi _ { 2 } , \xi _ { 3 }$ 单位化，得到

$$
\eta_ {1} = \frac {\xi_ {1}}{\| \xi_ {1} \|} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} (1, 2, 1) ^ {T}, \quad \eta_ {2} = \frac {\xi_ {2}}{\| \xi_ {2} \|} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (- 1, 0, 1) ^ {T}, \quad \eta_ {3} = \frac {\xi_ {3}}{\| \xi_ {3} \|} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} (1, - 1, 1) ^ {T}.
$$

令 $Q = \left( \eta _ { 1 } , \eta _ { 2 } , \eta _ { 3 } \right) = \left( \begin{array} { c c c } { { \frac 1 { \sqrt { 6 } } } } & { { - \frac 1 { \sqrt { 2 } } } } & { { \frac 1 { \sqrt { 3 } } } } \\ { { \frac 2 { \sqrt { 6 } } } } & { { 0 } } & { { - \frac 1 { \sqrt { 3 } } } } \\ { { \frac 1 { \sqrt { 6 } } } } & { { \frac 1 { \sqrt { 2 } } } } & { { \frac 1 { \sqrt { 3 } } } } \end{array} \right)$ ，则 $Q ^ { T } A Q = \Lambda = \left( \begin{array} { c c } { { 2 } } & { { } } \\ { { } } & { { } } \\ { { - 4 } } & { { } } \\ { { } } & { { } } \\ { { } } & { { } } \end{array} \right)$
